post.summary: Explain the change of a Measure between one time bucket and the bucket before it
post.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P2 (I-4, I-5, I-6), Business Insights add-on. Open to anyone who may view the dataset (no capability; rate-limited). Every statement runs through the gates of POST /bi/query as the caller (dataset visibility, SQL guard, sandbox, masking): a classified dimension value comes back as its alias. Body: dataset, optional filters / when, exactly one of measure {agg, field} or ratio {num, den} (sum or count only - a non-additive aggregate is refused in words), field (date column), grain (day | week | month), at (a date inside the bucket to explain), dimensions (1-12), optional cover (0.5-1, default 0.8), related (0-10 Measures) and lookback (8-60 buckets, default 24). drivers: per dimension the contribution, share of the change and Jensen-Shannon surprise of each value, and the fewest values covering cover x the change; ranked. mixRate (ratio only): the exact shift-share split mix + rate = change. movedWith: correlation of the bucket-to-bucket changes, at least 8 pairs; never a cause. A dimension with more than 200 values is listed in refused. Optional depth (1 default, or 2; BI-EXPLAIN-DEPTH2-1): depth 2 also returns pairs of dimensions precomputed by the insight.scan Job for an Insight Profile with pairs: true over the same dataset, Measure, date column, grain, filters and condition, read only from a Profile whose Insights Dataset the caller may view; none -> pairs null and pairsNote says how to get them. A ratio with depth 2 is refused (422).

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {measure, kind (additive | ratio), grain, previous, current, before, after, delta, pct, cover, drivers[{dimension, explains, covered, surprise, cover[], elements[{value, before, after, contribution, share, surprise}] (top 20), valueCount}], mixRate[{dimension, before, after, mix, rate, parts[{value, w0, w1, r0, r1, mix, rate}]}] (ratio only), refused[{dimension, reason}], movedWith[{measure, before, after, pairs, r, movedWith, reason?}], movedWithNote, pairs? {profile, computedAt, measure, grain, previous, current, before, after, cover, stale, drivers[] (as drivers, dimension = 'a × b'), refused[]} | null (depth 2 only), pairsNote?, masking?}

404.description: The dataset is unknown or not visible to the caller.

422.description: A bad body, a non-additive aggregate, no value in one of the two buckets, a Measure the caller sees masked, or a failed statement.

503.description: No Space write root, or the Business Insights module is not installed.

get.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P3 (I-8), Business Insights add-on. Read-shaped like POST /bi/query: whoever may view the Dataset insights_<profile> (404 otherwise, indistinguishable from none). Insights of the latest run (run=all: every run kept, 400 days), best score first, the readers' current feedback laid over status. Slice values are stored as a reader who may not reveal sees them (a classified value is its alias).

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {profile, runs, latestRun, total, insights[{insight_id, profile_id, run_id, run_at, insight_key, insight_type (anomaly | trend-break | drift), measure, dimension ('*' = the whole Measure), slice_value, period, value, expected, delta, impact, p, q, score, band, explanation{test, statistic, p, q, tests, impact, surprise, novelty, sentence, ...}, query (the /bi/query body that reads the slice's dimension), status (new | useful | not_useful | expected), first_seen, feedback?}]}

404.description: No such Insight, or the Profile's Insights Dataset is unknown or not visible to the caller.

503.description: No Space write root, or the Business Insights module is not installed.

get.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P4 (BR-0), Business Insights add-on, every edition, no language model. Read-shaped like GET /insights: each Profile by the caller's view of the Dataset insights_<profile>; a Profile the caller may not view (or that does not exist) is OMITTED, the others still answer. Per Profile: the latest run's Insights of band elevated or high, status not not_useful / expected, best score first (ties by insight_id), at most max, each as its stored templated sentence plus a link into the feed. Nothing qualifying -> summary 'Nothing unusual in <period>'. A latest run older than two grains of the Profile -> note 'Last scan was <n> days ago'. Slice values are stored aliases, so a revealer and a reader who may not reveal receive the same text.

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Comma-separated Insight Profile ids, at most 5.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {profiles[{profile, runId, runAt, period, header, stale, note?, summary?, lines[{insightId, band, score, sentence, type, dimension, slice, period, value, expected, delta, link, query}]}]}. A Profile never scanned, in a list of several, is an entry with a note naming the insight.scan Job and no lines.

404.description: A single requested Profile that is visible but has never been scanned (words name the insight.scan Job).

503.description: No Space write root, or the Business Insights module is not installed.

post.summary: Replay an unsaved Insight Profile over history
post.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P3 (tuning by replay), gated on canAuthorWorkbench. Runs AS THE CALLER through the gates of POST /bi/query: one fetch of lookback + periods buckets, then the scan as of each of the last periods buckets, novelty carried run to run, no feedback. Nothing is saved. Body: profile (the insight-profile content), periods (4-52, default 12), asOf (a date; default today in the Space's zone).

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {periods, perPeriod[{period, count}], total, perPeriodAverage, insights[] (top 50 by score, each with asOf), skipped[{dimension, reason}], masking?}

404.description: No such Insight, or the Profile's Insights Dataset is unknown or not visible to the caller.

503.description: No Space write root, or the Business Insights module is not installed.

post.description: BI-INSIGHTS-1 P3. Open to anyone who may view the Insights Dataset (no capability; the caller's own opinion). The status is recorded for the Insight's type x slice (the latest word wins) with the authenticated actor; the next insight.scan run writes it into status and novelty - not_useful and expected suppress it.
